agendaItems.rawTitle:
File No. CRA26-26779
Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, Florida, approving Extension No. 2 of an existing Agreement for the provision of legal services by and between the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, Florida, and the law firm of Shepard, Smith, Hand & Brackins, P.A., providing a one (1) year extension to said agreement for the 2027 Fiscal Year for an amount not to exceed $250,000.00; authorizing the chair of the Community Redevelopment Agency to execute said agreement; providing an effective date.
agendaItems.background: On or about November 14, 2024, the CRA board adopted CRA Resolution No. 2024-23 approving an “Agreement for the Provision of Legal Services” between the CRA and the Firm (the “Agreement”).  Article II, Section A of the Agreement provides that the term of the Agreement is initially one (1) year but that the term of the Agreement may be extended, with the approval of the CRA Board, for up to a maximum of four (4) additional one (1) terms (for a maximum term of five (5) years) provided that such “Extensions” of the Agreement are in writing and executed by both the Firm and the Chair of the CRA Board (upon approval of the CRA Board); The CRA Board and Firm exercised the option to extend the Agreement by executing Extension No. 1 pursuant to CRA Resolution 2025-18 (“Extension No. 1”), adopted on September 11, 2025, and the term of said Agreement was for one (1) additional year that commenced on October 1, 2026, pursuant to the Extension No. 1.

Title
A Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, 
Florida, approving Extension No. 2 of an existing Agreement for the provision 
of legal services by and between the Community Redevelopment Agency of 
the City of Tampa, Florida, and the law firm of Shepard, Smith, Hand & 
Brackins, P.A., providing a one (1) year extension to said agreement for the 
2027 Fiscal Year for an amount not to exceed $250,000.00; authorizing the 
chair of the Community Redevelopment Agency to execute said agreement; 
providing an effective date.
BACKGROUND:
On or about November 14, 2024, the CRA board adopted CRA Resolution No. 2024-23 
approving an “Agreement for the Provision of Legal Services” between the CRA and the Firm 
(the “Agreement”).  Article II, Section A of the Agreement provides that the term of the 
Agreement is initially one (1) year but that the term of the Agreement may be extended, with 
the approval of the CRA Board, for up to a maximum of four (4) additional one (1) terms (for a 
maximum term of five (5) years) provided that such “Extensions” of the Agreement are in 
writing and executed by both the Firm and the Chair of the CRA Board (upon approval of the 
CRA Board); The CRA Board and Firm exercised the option to extend the Agreement by 
executing Extension No. 1 pursuant to CRA Resolution 2025-18 (“Extension No. 1”), adopted 
on September 11, 2025, and the term of said Agreement was for one (1) additional year that 
commenced on October 1, 2026, pursuant to the Extension No. 1.
FISCAL IMPACT: Yes
FISCAL IMPACT STATEMENT:
This resolution provides for an agreement with Shepard, Smith, Hand & Brackins, P.A. in the 
amount of $250,000 for FY2027, subject to appropriation, for the CRA Administration within 
the General Fund.
